dispositions.description: every claim and every duplicate, each with exactly one disposition — nothing may lack one

disposition.description: confirmed (second confirmation passed) | unverified (survived refutation but not demonstrable here — kept, flagged) | rejected-with-reason | duplicate-of | debunked (refuted)

reason.description: required for rejected-with-reason, debunked, unverified (the concrete missing precondition), and for any disposition that overrides the handed-in verdict

duplicate_of.description: the surviving finding_id, required for duplicate-of

probe.description: the verdict's probe field carried over: a probe rule id, "none: <why>", or "manual: <kind>"

evidence.description: the verdict's decisive line — probe run or first evidence read

ranked_plan.description: the confirmed findings as one ranked fix plan, each with a route; severity and its effect/exposure cells carried verbatim

unverified.description: findings kept but not demonstrable in this environment — each with the concrete missing precondition, never a bare "not demonstrated"

funnel.description: the claim funnel across the round — stated as one line in the gate presentation

permanent_checks.description: for each confirmed finding that is a recurring class rather than a one-off: the durable check that would catch the class (ACDSL rule, lint rule, assertion, golden file, test) — the dispatcher offers to add them, never adds unasked; empty when every finding is a one-off

build_test.description: the rules tool's buildtest result at the review head, copied through verbatim

base_health.description: the rules tool's buildtest result at the review base, copied through verbatim

debunked.description: findings refuted by their second confirmation

resolved.description: findings already fixed out of band — finding to fixing-commit provenance

fixing_commit.description: the commit hash that fixed it

intentional_deviations.description: deviations to canonicalize rather than fix

coverage_gaps.description: manifest paths of lanes that did not finish — their files are the uncovered assignments

definition_of_done.description: the DoD walk — happens here in consolidation, it is not a direction

escalations.description: suspected but undemonstrated defects in migrations, auth, concurrency, money, a public API contract, or persisted data — surfaced FIRST in every presentation of the round, never one unverified line among many; empty when none

recommendation.description: APPROVE (no blocking finding — new, MINOR or worse, above ignore-level; NIT and INFO never block) | CONDITIONAL (blocking findings, mergeable once fixed) | REJECT (fundamental rework)

handoff_json.description: absolute path of the round's consolidated review.json — the single handoff artifact; no review.md exists

probes.description: one entry per probe the refuters and verifiers authored — THE probe→fixture→verdict index, mapped from the verdicts' probe/script/fixture fields; there is no sidecar verdicts file. Empty in non-ACDSL repos or when no probes were authored

script.description: the probe executable, path relative to probes_dir

fixture.description: the minimal fail fixture the probe went RED on in the validity check, path relative to probes_dir

registry.description: the probe's merged registry, path relative to probes_dir

probes_dir.description: absolute path of round-{r}/probes/ when any probe was authored — empty string otherwise
